name: Emperor Qianlong
description: Qianlong, the Emperor of the Qing Dynasty, worked diligently and loved the people, worked hard to govern, and created the Qianlong Era. His original name is Aixinjueluo Hongli, which is opposite to the word Qingying (i.e. Ruyi), and has the beautiful meaning of "green cherry and red lychee". He and Ruyi are childhood sweethearts who know each other and love each other. They are a truly talented and beautiful couple. The sweet green time between the two is a happy memory that he will never forget in his life. Turn the music box and feel the happy and sweet mood in the melodious melody.
